article.content: How will Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur fare today? Tottenham Hotspur similarly enter Saturday’s match with a spring in their step following Monday’s 3-1 victory over Coventry City , a result that lifted Roberto De Zerbi’s team off the foot of the Premier League table.
